TimeBound.description: the timebound refers to the temporal boundaries that indicate the start and end points of the time range represented in a specific NetCDF data file. These are two strings separated by a hyphen ("-"), and they typically encode dates in a standardized format (like YYYYMMDD) depending on the project: Granularity: The timebound can represent time at different levels of granularity depending on the type of data. It may be a year (YYYY), a year and month (YYYYMM), or a full date (YYYYMMDD), depending on the temporal resolution of the data (e.g., monthly, daily). Purpose: It helps users quickly identify which period of time the data covers, making it easier to manage and access specific time slices from large climate datasets.
